verdict.rationale: Probes show no agent-oriented documentation: https://undermind.ai/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant https://undermind.ai/mcp.md both return HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The official MCP server and its setup docs are a separate capability (an MCP-server story) and do not count as agent-readable docs for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
